hypothesis: A row-only adapter cannot distinguish a current stream whose release_batch_delivery_position field was deleted from every release row from a valid legacy-shaped stream when both retain input-release-batch-v3.
minimum_test: Compare current producer-shaped two-member stream with positions 0,1 against the same rows after deleting the field from all release rows. Compare its normalized row content and adapter output with the legacy-shaped stream.

decision_gate.unidentifiable: Rows and outputs are identical, both SOURCE_ROWS_JOINED / TEMPORALLY_UNIQUE: record representational limit, not live defect.
decision_gate.distinguishable: The adapter holds total loss while accepting legitimate legacy input using an identified row-level discriminator.

competing_explanation: Out-of-band session/source-version provenance could distinguish the traces; this experiment tests the row-only adapter interface.
uncertainty: Synthetic producer-shaped records; no evidence that total field loss happened in a live trace.
